items.abstract: <jats:p>Let F (k) i be the k-bonacci numbers with F (k) 1 = • • • = F (k) k = 1, and let h (k) 2,1 (n) be the number of odd coefficients of n i=1 1+x F (k) i+k-1. Stanley conjectured that n≥0 h (k) 2,1 (n)x n = (1 + 2x k)/(1-2x + 2x k-2x k+1) for every k ≥ 2. We prove this. The proof works with the supports of the products over F2 and shows that the overlap between consecutive supports is obtained from an earlier support by deleting two mirror-image copies of an earlier overlap. As a consequence we also prove Stanley's formula for the number of even coefficients when k = 2, and the case m = 2 of his Conjecture 6.2.</jats:p>

items.abstract: <jats:p>By means of the coefficient extraction method, we examine a transformation of a classical hypergeometric series. Three classes of infinite series (of convergence rate “1/4”) with harmonic numbers in numerators and cubic central binomial coefficients in denominators are expressed in terms of odd Euler sums. Several new closed formulae are established.</jats:p>
title: Odd Euler Sums and Harmonic Series with Cubic Central Binomial Coefficients in Denominators
